name: node-stop-before-tail
query: MATCH (n:IntConstant) RETURN n.id AS id LIMIT $l

name: zero-hop-stop-before-tail
query: MATCH (a {id:0})-[r*0..4]->(b) RETURN id(b) AS id LIMIT $l

name: single-hop-stop-before-tail
query: MATCH (a {id:0})-[r]->(b) RETURN id(b) AS id LIMIT $l

name: projection-before-tail
query: MATCH (n:IntConstant) RETURN substring('x','bad') AS x LIMIT $l

name: consumed-corrupt-tail
query: MATCH (n:IntConstant) RETURN n.id AS id LIMIT $l
